text:
ashley: Ugh CI on main just turned red after merging my tiny docs PR. pre-commit is failing with mypy errors in unrelated files, anyone else seeing this?

sam: link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/9821 (pre-commit failure)

infra-bot: [automated] Build #9821 failed — failing hooks: mypy, isort. See details: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/9821/logs 

ashley: Pasting the failing snippet from the job: 
```
+ mypy src/
src/runtime/serve.py:42: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "str")
Found 1 error in 1 file (errors prevented further checking)
pre-commit: mypy hook returned non-zero exit status 2
```

mike: Was mypy pinned? I remember a deps PR bumped mypy yesterday. Could be stricter checks in the new release.

laura: Ashley — can you confirm `pre-commit run --all-files` locally reproduces? sometimes CI environment exposes stricter settings.

ashley: Ran it locally, I get an error too but on a different file: 
```
src/utils/cache.py:87: error: "None" cannot be assigned to variable of type "str"  [assignment]
```
So both spots are complaining about Optional handling.

sam: @mike did your bump include config changes (strict optional) or was it only package? If it was the bump we should bisect to the PR that landed it. @laura can you try a quick git bisect between origin/main~20 and HEAD?

laura: I'll bisect now — stepping through with an automated typecheck run.

laura: Bisect commands I used: 
```
git fetch origin
git bisect start HEAD origin/main~20
git bisect run tox -e typecheck
```

laura: Found culprit: commit 6a1b2c3c "deps: upgrade mypy to 1.8.2" — that matches the dependency bump yesterday.

mike: That's my PR, sorry — I missed that 1.8 tightened optional/None rules. I can follow up with necessary code fixes. For a quick unblock, do we want to revert the bump or add targeted ignores?

sam: Prefer not to revert the upgrade long term. Short term options: 1) Add explicit None handling / casts where the errors are, 2) add a narrow "# type: ignore[...]" with a follow-up ticket, or 3) relax a specific mypy flag in config if it's too noisy.

ashley: For my immediate blocker I pushed a tiny revert that prevents CI from failing so I can get my docs PR merged. Pushed as commit 9f4d2e1. Can someone re-run CI? @dev-bot 

dev-bot: Re-run triggered for build 9823 by ashley — https://ci.redwood.example/runs/9823

infra-bot: Rerun complete: build 9823 — all pre-commit hooks passed :tada: (mypy 1.8.2 is still in deps on main after revert PR not merged yet)

ashley: Thanks everyone — PR merged, unblocked. I'll open a follow-up issue to make codebase compatible with mypy 1.8.2 rather than relying on permanent ignores.

mike: I'll own the follow-up and start a small branch to fix the Optional usages and add tests. Sorry for the noise. :slightly_smiling_face:

laura: Nice bisecting and quick triage, team. If anyone wants the bisect logs I can paste them. :confetti_ball:

ashley: Please paste them real quick, laura — helps for postmortem notes.

laura: Pasted bisect output to #eng-infra thread. End of thread.
